name: australian-legislation
description: Verify Commonwealth, State and Territory legislation and trace Commonwealth legislative change against official Australian sources.

interface.shortDescription: Verify Australian legislation and historical versions.
interface.longDescription: Checks Commonwealth, State and Territory legislation against each jurisdiction's official publisher, identifies applicable point-in-time versions and commencement qualifications, traces Commonwealth legislative change, and fails closed when authoritative source or currency evidence is incomplete.
defaultPrompt: Verify this Australian legislative provision against the applicable official point-in-time source.
Trace how this Commonwealth provision changed across the requested dates.
